meta.important_question: Will CivicSquare materially rollback or suspend the contested group-admin tool changes rather than merely reframe them?

realization_criteria: official platform notice states rollback, pause, or restoration of one or more core contested admin features
affected creators or moderators confirm functional restoration is live or scheduled

meta.important_question: Will the platform respond to pressure by making moderation stricter instead of softer?

the matter moves beyond informal inquiry into documented enforceable resolution
